description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarProviderInstanceFactory class, responsible for creating instances of calendar providers based on specified types. It includes methods for instantiating providers, handling errors, and managing provider connections. The class relies on other classes such as CalendarProviderType, CalendarAccount, and AbstractCalendarProvider, and dynamically loads provider files.

classes.name: CalendarProviderInstanceFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and initializing instances of calendar providers based on provided types, including validation of file existence and class inheritance.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a calendar provider instance if the specified type is enabled, sets its connection, and handles errors during instantiation.

methods.name: instantiateProvider
methods.description: Loads the provider file, verifies the class exists and extends the correct base class, then instantiates and returns the provider object.
